g.text: Cost and latency · medians across low / medium / high reasoning
Teal: Nanocodex; orange: Agents; gray: Responses. Circles: default; triangles: fast. Cost bars reflect unknown cache-write premiums.
Model-token estimates only; not invoices. Missing or late usage, Cloudflare infrastructure and external tools are excluded. Correctness is reported separately.
